source.description: Post-check payload for a Bash tool that ran cargo build. Pins bug #1 (0.13.2): Claude Code delivers Bash output under `tool_response`, not `tool_output`. The runner replays this and asserts `outcome:compile_ok` appears on a fresh journal record — impossible if the alias is absent.
